direction: Build local soccer community through recognizable clubs, real match moments and useful discovery.

allowed: Current public club/program/place profile totals from the CMS
Genuine submissions, members or partners once evidenced
A specific upcoming match or event date
A registration deadline explicitly stated by the organizer
A waitlist explicitly stated by the organizer
An invitation to help build Cancha early
avoid: Made-up last spots or ticket scarcity
Calling an event end date a registration deadline
Describing unconfirmed clubs or brands as partners

dailyMix.secondSlot: Source-checked motion story when ready, otherwise another fresh photo carousel

video.footage: Exact-topic official club clips or owner-supplied footage
video.broadcastHighlights: Use a permitted direct file or owner-supplied clip; do not bypass a player, login or download restriction
video.narration: Generic off-screen synthetic narration, never a fabricated player or coach quote

evaluate: Watch time and completion when accessible
